subject: Saltonstall Building Modernization
overview: The Commission reviewed a Notice of Intent for the comprehensive modernization of the Saltonstall Building at 121 Riverside Avenue and associated site improvements. The board discussed environmental resource area impacts and stormwater management before continuing the public hearing to a future date.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting as amended.

items.title: 121 Riverside Avenue - Saltonstall Building Modernization
items.summary: The Medford Housing Authority presented a plan for a building renovation and site work including 47 new trees and upgraded bio-retention stormwater systems near the Mystic River. Discussion focused on soil infiltration rates, water quality volume requirements, and coordination with DCR's Clippership Path project. Referred to a continued hearing on November 16 to allow the applicant to address technical questions regarding stormwater calculations and erosion controls.

items.title: Other Business and Updates
items.summary: The Environmental Agent announced a new filing for a gas line project on Winthrop Street and provided construction updates for the former convent site and ongoing zoning appeals.
